text:
# Steam Power Research

Section: Research Path > Makes available

## Steam Power

[![Genericresearch](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/11/Genericresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421181620)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/11/Genericresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421181620)

### Research Points

20

### Research Time

1h 50m

## Research Path

### Unlocked by

[Industrial Equipment](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Industrial_Equipment_Research)

### Makes available

[Nuclear Power](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Nuclear_Power_Research)

Steam power is a [researchable](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research) item which unlocks the following components:

| Category | Component |
| --- | --- |
| Industry | Firebox |
| Industry | Firebox Large |
| Industry | Steam Boiler |
| Industry | Steam Condenser |
| Industry | Steam Turbine |
| Industry | Steam Piston (Small) |
| Industry | Steam Piston (Medium) |
| Industry | Steam Piston (Large) |
| [Fluid](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Game_Mechanics/Fluids) | Steam Whistle |
